children.name: Evidence
children.value: MP4 layout of Apple's AudioToolbox encoder: a DecoderConfigDescriptor whose stream type byte is 0x14 (reserved bit 0) and an sbtd box in the sample entry, which records the PCM source of an encode (at 0x1EA)

children.name: Evidence
children.value: MP4 layout of Apple's AudioToolbox file writer: a DecoderConfigDescriptor whose stream type byte is 0x14 (reserved bit 0) and a free box that pads the audio data to a 4,096-byte boundary (at 0x192)
